title: Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle
title_zh: 可信合成视觉媒体：证据贯穿媒体生命周期

paragraphs.en: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.
paragraphs.zh: 图像和视频长期以来帮助人们了解发生了什么，以及一件作品是如何产生的。 生成式系统使这一作用变得复杂。 如今可以生成和修改逼真的媒体内容，而不会留下稳定的历史记录，因此外观本身已无法表明一个场景是被拍摄、合成，还是在过程中被篡改的。 信任必须转而来自能够解释一个资产所经历的路径及其使用环境的证据。 其中一些证据可以从媒体本身恢复，而另一些则必须在制作过程中记录下来，并随着资产的传播加以保存。 本文综述将这些方法汇集在一起，并探讨它们的主张在经历常规处理或蓄意操纵之后是否仍然有意义。 我们认为，可信赖的媒体并不依赖于某种统一的真实性标志。 证据必须契合眼前的问题，传递到做出判断的人手中，并且在出现更好的信息时保持可修正性。 更宏大的目标是，即使在媒体本身不断变化的情况下，仍能让媒体的历史保持可理解。
